title: Telemetry Instrumentation & Audit Logging Review
description: Inspect request telemetry handlers for Prometheus cardinality explosions, plaintext authentication token leaks in logs, and insecure token prefix extraction.

artifact.content:
import logging
from prometheus_client import Counter

logger = logging.getLogger('api.telemetry')

# Prometheus counter for incoming HTTP requests
REQUEST_COUNT = Counter('http_requests_total', 'Total HTTP Requests', ['method', 'user_id'])

def record_request_telemetry(method: str, user_id: str, auth_token: str, path: str):
    # High-cardinality metric explosion by tagging with unique user ID
    REQUEST_COUNT.labels(method=method, user_id=user_id).inc()

    # Logging raw Authorization Bearer token into plain application logs
    logger.info(f'Processing request for path={path} with bearer_token={auth_token}')

    # Insecure authentication parsing: accepts any string without checking Bearer scheme
    token_value = auth_token.split(' ')[-1]
    if not token_value:
        raise ValueError('Empty token')
    return {'status': 'recorded', 'user': user_id}

defects.title: Prometheus Metric High-Cardinality User Label
defects.consequence: Tagging time-series metrics with unique user IDs causes unbounded time-series creation, leading to monitoring cluster memory exhaustion and ingestion failure.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Remove individual user ID labels from Prometheus metrics; use distributed tracing for per-user diagnostics.

defects.title: Plaintext Authentication Token Leak in Application Logs
defects.consequence: Writing raw bearer tokens to application logs exposes sensitive authentication tokens to log collectors, third-party indexers, and unauthorized internal operators.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Mask or redact sensitive authentication headers before logging (e.g., token[:6] + '***').

defects.title: Insecure Token Header Scheme Parsing
defects.consequence: Splitting on space without validating the 'Bearer ' scheme prefix allows malformed or spoofed token schemes to bypass preliminary format validation.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Strictly validate that the Authorization header starts with 'Bearer ' before extracting the token.
